units.source_text: 一阵哆嗦，那月亮表面，使他联想到斑斑驳驳撒了些粗粉，疮痂一样的手感……

en.t: A shudder ran through him; the surface of the moon made him think of coarse powder scattered in mottled patches, a scab-like texture...

units.source_text: 还使人联想起锈迹斑斑的铝饭盒……

en.t: It also brought to mind an aluminum lunch box mottled with rust...

units.source_text: 接近焦点，在那儿更让人联想起意料不到的影像：白色的骷髅……

en.t: Near the focal point, it called up an even more unexpected image: a white skeleton...

units.source_text: 万国通用的标志，毒的徽章……

en.t: the universal sign, the emblem of poison...

units.source_text: 杀虫瓶底部抹着白粉的药片……

en.t: tablets coated with white powder at the bottom of an insecticide bottle...

units.source_text: 这样说来，风化的氰酸钾药片和月亮的表面，气质竟会如此相像。

en.t: Now that he thought of it, weathered potassium cyanide tablets and the surface of the moon had a surprisingly similar quality.

units.source_text: 那个瓶，还原封不动埋在靠房门的横框底下吧……

en.t: That bottle must still be buried untouched under the crosspiece by the room door...
